d: A stylized horse creature with an ivory-white body and a thick, braided ivory-white mane and tail. The creature has narrow, expressionless black eyes and a slender, sculpted build, featuring several chipped areas of paint that reveal a dark underlayer and red markings on the lower legs. It is equipped with a brown leather harness, a matching saddle with an orange fabric panel and gold detailing, and stands atop four gold-rimmed spoked wheels. BODY COLOR: ivory-white
